name: BCL11A 95kb CONTROL (uniform occupancy 0.7 for all enhancers)
description: Focused 95kb window spanning BCL11A intron 2 erythroid enhancer complex (DHS +55/+58/+62). Resolution 600bp, 159 bins — matches HBB 95kb sub-TAD (27 pearls). CTCF sites from ENCODE K562 ChIP-seq (ENCFF736NYC). Enhancers from literature: Bauer et al. Science 2013, Canver et al. Nature 2015. DHS +58 is the Casgevy (exagamglogene autotemcel) CRISPR target — GATA1 binding site disruption to reactivate fetal hemoglobin.

enhancers.note: Erythroid DHS +58 functional core (chr2:60495079-60495307, 228bp). Casgevy sgRNA target at chr2:60495263-60495283 (GATA1 motif). Canver et al. Nature 2015, Frangoul et al. NEJM 2021.
